system.description:
This incantation briefly grants speech to an inanimate object no larger than a cottage. The chosen item speaks from whatever mouth-like opening you think makes most sense, or otherwise grows a simple mouth with which to elocute. An object speaks in the languages known to its crafter and can relate events that have taken place near it, to a point.

An object has allegiance to its most recent owner, provided it has been treated fairly well, and may regard you warily. The conversation lasts no longer than 10 minutes (1 dungeon action).

With no sparks, the object is able to answer simple yes-or-no questions; with one, its vocabulary is limited to simple phrases and terms; with two, it may speak with a level of sophistication befitting the quality of its craftsmanship; and with three or more, the object speaks impeccably and will readily impart whatever it knows.
